title: The census reports say Haiku 5.5 is the batch judge's default, not the phase-4 checker's
goal: kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md (Bars, Not measured) and kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md stop calling Haiku 5.5 the default of the checker's passage judgments, since the checker keeps the session's model (ST-tef5gzq7), and compare --decide's check line says it is a measurement, not a default

run:
import sys
r=lambda p:' '.join(open(p,encoding='utf-8').read().split())
f=r('kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md');b=r('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md')
bad=[x for x,t in (('Haiku 5.5 is the default of the passage judgments',f),('so Haiku 5.5 is their default',b)) if x in t]
print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
